title: If I create a new profile do I still have access to messages, schedules, etc. that existed under the previous profile?
creator: mykeal
content: I'm getting frequent popup messages from McAfee, my email threat detector, that they've detected and stopped a threat, but none is identified. McAfee's chatbot wants me to create a new profile and add my email accounts to that profile. Will I lose access to all my currently saved email messages and calendar information?

title: Thunderbird has created more than one in box. Very confusing.
creator: dean.farrow
content: My normal inbox is a blue envelope at the very top of the left hand list. Recently, another inbox, a yellow folder further down, has appeared. It has a Trash above it. There are emails in it. There is nothing in the top Trash. My incoming emails seem to jump between these two. Also some emails seem to be disappearing. This is not ideal, and didn't used to happen.
